<style>
/* Обертка для iframe, которую создает скрипт */
[data-kineskope="iframe_wrap"] {
  position: relative; 
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  z-index: 5; /* Выше дефолтной обложки при воспроизведении */
}

[data-kineskope="iframe_wrap"] iframe {
  object-fit: cover;
  position: absolute; 
  width: 100%; 
  height: 100%; 
  top: 0; 
  left: 0;
}

[data-kineskope="cover"] img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* Изменение z-index вместо скрытия во избежание вспышек */
[data-kineskope="cover"].video-is-playing {
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Кнопка Play */
[data-kineskope="play"] {
  z-index: 100;
}

/* Кнопку скрываем сразу при клике */
[data-kineskope="play"].hidden {
  opacity: 0 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* --- СТИЛИ ПРЕЛОАДЕРА --- */
[data-kineskope="loader"] {
  z-index: 20; 
  opacity: 0;
  animation: kinescopeSpinner 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* Показываем лоадер, добавляя класс */
[data-kineskope="loader"].is-loading {
  opacity: 1;
}

@keyframes kinescopeSpinner {
  to { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); }
}
</style>

<script>
const isSafariLike = (
  /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
  /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
  (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1)
);

let kinescopeApiPromise = null;
let kinescopeFactory = null;

function loadKinescopeApi() {
  if (kinescopeFactory) return Promise.resolve(kinescopeFactory);
  if (kinescopeApiPromise) return kinescopeApiPromise;

  kinescopeApiPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    window.onKinescopeIframeAPIReady = function(playerFactory) {
      kinescopeFactory = playerFactory;
      resolve(playerFactory);
    };

    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://player.kinescope.io/latest/iframe.player.js';
    script.async = true;
    script.onerror = reject;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });

  return kinescopeApiPromise;
}

function getRawVideoUrl(embedParent) {
  return embedParent.getAttribute('data-src');
}

function getApiVideoUrl(embedParent) {
  const rawSrc = getRawVideoUrl(embedParent);
  if (!rawSrc) return null;
  return rawSrc.replace(/\/embed/g, '').replace(/embed/g, '');
}

function getEmbedVideoUrl(embedParent, autoplay) {
  const rawSrc = getRawVideoUrl(embedParent);
  if (!rawSrc) return null;

  let url = rawSrc.includes('/embed/')
    ? rawSrc
    : rawSrc.replace('https://kinescope.io/', 'https://kinescope.io/embed/');

  if (autoplay) {
    url += url.includes('?') ? '&autoplay=1' : '?autoplay=1';
  }
  return url;
}

function getOrCreateWrap(embedParent) {
  let wrap = embedParent.querySelector('[data-kineskope="iframe_wrap"]');
  if (!wrap) {
    wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.setAttribute('data-kineskope', 'iframe_wrap');
    embedParent.appendChild(wrap);
  }
  return wrap;
}

function setIframePointer(card, enabled) {
  const iframe = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="iframe_wrap"] iframe');
  if (!iframe) return;
  iframe.style.pointerEvents = enabled ? 'auto' : 'none';
}

// Сброс состояний (Пауза / Конец видео): возвращаем кнопку и обложку, гасим лоадер
function showPlay(card) {
  const playBtn = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="play"]');
  const coverImg = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="cover"]');
  const loader = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="loader"]');
  card.dataset.videoState = 'paused';

  if (playBtn) playBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
  if (coverImg) coverImg.classList.remove('video-is-playing');
  if (loader) loader.classList.remove('is-loading');
  
  setIframePointer(card, false);
}

// Видео начало успешно играть: прячем лоадер, опускаем обложку под плеер
function hidePlay(card) {
  const coverImg = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="cover"]');
  const loader = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="loader"]');
  card.dataset.videoState = 'playing';

  if (coverImg) coverImg.classList.add('video-is-playing');
  if (loader) loader.classList.remove('is-loading');
  
  setIframePointer(card, true);
}

// Safari / iOS iframe
function createSafariIframe(card) {
  const embedParent = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="embed"]');
  if (!embedParent) return null;

  const wrap = getOrCreateWrap(embedParent);
  let iframe = wrap.querySelector('iframe');
  if (iframe) return iframe;

  const videoSrc = getEmbedVideoUrl(embedParent, true);
  if (!videoSrc) return null;

  iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.src = videoSrc;
  iframe.setAttribute('allow', 'autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture; encrypted-media; gyroscope; accelerometer; clipboard-write; screen-wake-lock');
  iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
  iframe.setAttribute('allowfullscreen', 'true');

  iframe.addEventListener('load', () => {
    setTimeout(() => hidePlay(card), 400);
  });

  wrap.appendChild(iframe);
  return iframe;
}

function removeSafariIframe(card) {
  const iframe = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="iframe_wrap"] iframe');
  if (iframe) iframe.remove();
  showPlay(card);
}

// Инициализация API плеера Kinescope
function initApiCard(card) {
  if (card.kPlayer) return Promise.resolve(card.kPlayer);
  if (card.kPlayerPromise) return card.kPlayerPromise;

  const embedParent = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="embed"]');
  if (!embedParent) return Promise.resolve(null);

  const videoSrc = getApiVideoUrl(embedParent);
  if (!videoSrc) return Promise.resolve(null);

  const wrap = getOrCreateWrap(embedParent);
  const holder = document.createElement('div');
  holder.id = 'kinescope-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 11);
  wrap.insertBefore(holder, wrap.firstChild);

  card.kPlayerPromise = loadKinescopeApi()
    .then(playerFactory => {
      return playerFactory.create(holder.id, {
        url: videoSrc,
        size: { width: '100%', height: '100%' },
        behavior: { autoPlay: true, muted: false, playsInline: true },
        ui: { controls: true, mainPlayButton: false }
      });
    })
    .then(player => {
      card.kPlayer = player;

      player.on(player.Events.Playing, () => hidePlay(card));
      player.on(player.Events.Pause, () => showPlay(card));
      player.on(player.Events.Ended, () => showPlay(card));

      return player;
    })
    .catch(err => {
      card.kPlayerPromise = null;
      showPlay(card);
      console.error('Kinescope init error:', err);
    });

  return card.kPlayerPromise;
}

function playCard(card) {
  videoObserver.observe(card);

  // Сразу гасим кнопку Play и включаем прелоадер поверх обложки
  const playBtn = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="play"]');
  const loader = card.querySelector('[data-kineskope="loader"]');
  
  if (playBtn) playBtn.classList.add('hidden');
  if (loader) loader.classList.add('is-loading');

  if (isSafariLike) {
    createSafariIframe(card);
    return;
  }

  initApiCard(card).then(player => {
    if (player) {
      player.play().catch(err => {
        showPlay(card);
        console.error('Kinescope play error:', err);
      });
    }
  });
}

function pauseCard(card) {
  if (isSafariLike) {
    removeSafariIframe(card);
    return;
  }

  const player = card.kPlayer;
  if (player) {
    player.pause().catch(err => console.error('Kinescope pause error:', err));
  } else {
    showPlay(card);
  }
}

// Автопауза при скролле
const videoObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (!entry.isIntersecting) {
      pauseCard(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1 });

// Глобальный клик
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  const card = e.target.closest('[data-widget="kineskope"]');
  if (!card) return;

  const isPlaying = card.dataset.videoState === 'playing';

  if (isPlaying) {
    if (!e.target.closest('[data-kineskope="iframe_wrap"] iframe')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      pauseCard(card);
    }
  } else {
    e.preventDefault();
    playCard(card);
  }
});

// Стартовая настройка
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-widget="kineskope"]').forEach(card => {
    card.dataset.videoState = 'paused';
    setIframePointer(card, false);
  });
});
</script>
